topic: Asking About a Car Loan Payment

script.title: QUESTIONS ABOUT MY CAR LOAN
script.story_hook: A busy dad quietly rethinks his monthly car payment.
script.intro_zh: 一位忙碌老爸重新盤算每月的車貸繳款。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, dear listeners! Today we're asking a banker about a car loan.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，親愛的聽眾朋友！今天我們跟著一位客戶向銀行諮詢車貸。
script.outro: That's all for this one! Listen twice and you'll own it. Bye for now!
script.outro_zh: 這一集就到這裡！聽兩遍就會變成你的。先說再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Here we go — repeat each line right after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 開始囉——每一句都緊跟著我馬上重複。

Repeat every line in the second half and talk to your bank with confidence.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🚗車貸英文｜設自動扣款・多繳本金・清償報價｜聽完就會問貸款｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
車貸繳了好久，金額為什麼都不會變？
想提前還清，用英文該從哪裡問起？

這一集帶大家走進銀行的貸款諮詢桌，跟著一位老爸從抱怨老是忘記繳款日，到設定自動扣款、確認每月金額固定、把多繳的錢直接衝本金，最後還要到一份提前清償報價，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🔁 自動扣款：例如「I keep missing my due date.」、「Autopay fixes that. Want me to set it up?」。
📈 多繳與本金：例如「Can I pay extra each month?」、「Extra cash goes straight to principal.」。
🧮 清償報價：例如「Could I get a payoff quote?」、「I'll email you the full breakdown.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完這一集，下次坐進銀行談貸款，輪到你把問題問漂亮！

script.title_quote: Could I get a payoff quote?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I have a car loan with your bank.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ hæv ə kɑr loʊn wɪð jɔr bæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 你好，我在你們銀行有一筆汽車貸款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. What can I check for you today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt wɑt kæn aɪ tʃɛk fɚ ju təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好的。今天想查詢些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I keep missing my due date.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ kip ˈmɪsɪŋ maɪ ˈduː deɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Autopay fixes that. Want me to set it up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔˌtoʊˌpeɪ fɪksəz ðæt wɑnt mi tə sɛt ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 自動扣款就能解決。要我幫你設定嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please. Straight from this checking account?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliːz streɪt frʌm ðɪs ˈtʃɛkɪŋ əˈkaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 好，麻煩了。直接從這個活存戶扣款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. It drafts on the fifth of each month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ɪt dræfts ɑn ðə fɪfθ əv itʃ mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 正是如此。每個月的五號自動扣款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. My payment amount won't change?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我的每月繳款額不會變吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, it stays flat until the very end.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp ɪt steɪz flæt ənˈtɪl ðə ˈvɛri ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 不會，會一路固定到繳完為止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Quick one — can I pay extra each month?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kwɪk wʌn kæn aɪ peɪ ˈɛkstrə itʃ mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 好。再快速問一個——每月可以多繳一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, extra cash goes straight to principal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ˈɛkstrə kæʃ ɡoʊz streɪt tə ˈprɪnsəpəl/
dialogue.zh: 可以，多繳的錢會直接扣到本金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, so that cuts the loan short, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs soʊ ðæt kʌts ðə loʊn ʃɔrt raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不錯，這樣貸款就能提前結束，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — two or three months off, maybe more.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu ɔr θri mʌnθs ɔf ˈmeɪbi mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 對——能縮短兩三個月，說不定更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Love that. Could I get a payoff quote?
dialogue.phonetic: /lʌv ðæt kʊd aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈpeɪˌɔf kwoʊt/
dialogue.zh: 太喜歡了。可以給我一份清償報價嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Planning to close it early, huh?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs ˈplænɪŋ tə kloʊz ɪt ˈɜrli hʌʔ/
dialogue.zh: 當然。你打算提前把貸款結清嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe next year. Just curious about the number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi nɛkst jɪr dʒʌst ˈkjʊriəs əˈbaʊt ðə ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 也許明年吧。只是想知道確切數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today it's fourteen thousand, two hundred ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ ɪts fɔrˈtin ˈθaʊzənd tu ˈhʌndrəd tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 以今天的數字來看，是一萬四千二百一十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, that's closer than I thought, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðæts ˈkloʊsɚ ðæn aɪ θɔt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 哇，老實說，比我想像中還要接近了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice! I'll email you the full breakdown.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs aɪ ˈiˌmeɪl ju ðə fʊl ˈbreɪkˌdaʊn/
dialogue.zh: 好啊！我把完整的明細用電子郵件寄給你。
